text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Zimbabwean government, with the assistance of the British Government, is soon to launch the second phase of its land acquisition and resettlement programme that will see more land being acquired, paving way for the equitable distribution of the resource.
- Zimbabwe is losing millions of dollars through commercial farmers running wildlife ranches who ask tourists on hunting safaris to deposit payments into their foreign accounts.

The first winter wheat irrigation scheme for communal farmers opened in 1989 by president Robert Mugabe Zimbabwe's Mashonaland Central province has been abandoned because of the crop's high imput costs and unattractive producer prices.
